payload.title: Prove singleton BUSY/task lease with generation fencing

work_clay.purpose: Turn the owner-fixed single-spawn/BUSY rule into stale-holder-safe execution semantics by binding a monotonically advancing lease_generation/task_epoch to every consequential effect, durable task transition and terminal completion receipt.
minimum_semantics: at most one current lease generation may authorize the active task
lease transfer/interrupt increments or otherwise invalidates the prior generation
effect gateway checks request/session/task/lease generation before consequential attempt
durable state transition and terminal completion receipt bind the same current generation
late/stale holder request is rejected even if its token/session was previously valid
crash/restart reconstructs the current generation without resurrecting prior holder authority
duplicate/replayed completion cannot terminate or overwrite a newer task
non_goals: lease generation is not standalone effect authority
read-only observation is not blocked unless owner policy requires it

reason_clay.current_gap: Fresh target-VPS self.root evidence explicitly lists exclusive instance lease as not yet proven while current owner semantics require singleton BUSY/handoff behavior.
reason_clay.strongest_conventional_baseline: Chubby-style lock sequencer/generation checked by the protected service + current Frank session/task epochs + ordinary idempotency/request identity.
external_primary_evidence: Burrows, Chubby OSDI 2006 sequencer with lock generation and recipient validity check
IETF OAuth delegation/scope patterns remain credential layer, distinct from execution lease
internal_evidence: go-20260810T2242p0700 self.root replay receipt: exclusive instance lease not proven
recent BUSY-to-interrupt and explicit interactive idle-handoff deltas

payload.strongest_counterhypothesis: Existing authenticated session/task epoch plus atomic server-side BUSY compare-and-set already prevents every realistic stale-holder effect; an added generation field provides no unique protection and only increases coordination state.

completion_clay.baseline: current BUSY/session/task mechanism without additional generation fencing
completion_clay.candidate: generation-fenced singleton lease integrated at effect/persistence/completion boundaries
faults: duplicate completion after newer task begins
effect accepted before crash but completion delayed
replayed API request with stale task generation
completion_clay.promotion: Only if the candidate eliminates a stale-holder/ABA class not already eliminated by the simpler baseline without unacceptable latency/resource/recovery cost

executor_policy.prefer: worker touching token API/effect authority/recovery with accepted-target VPS capability
executor_policy.safe_write: append-only evidence first; target code only under normal repo/PR authority

dependencies: target VPS test lane remains available
invalidators: new current-source receipt proves equivalent generation/fencing semantics and passes listed faults
another active worker already claimed the exact same work revision
